say:1:1620847001:1.text: *Yawn*... You guys are finally done talking. So, what's your decision?
say:1:1620847001:1.source_cn: 呵欠……你们总算讨论完了，怎么样，得出结论了吗？

choice_prompt:2:1620847001.text: *Yawn*... You guys are finally done talking. So, what's your decision?
choice_prompt:2:1620847001.source_cn: 呵欠……你们总算讨论完了，怎么样，得出结论了吗？

say:5:1620847003:1.text: Yeah! Seal me or not, I'm stuck working here anyway, so I might as well make the most of this chance to have some fun!
say:5:1620847003:1.source_cn: 重点当然是跑团！反正无论结局如何我都要留在莱希拉姆打工...

say:6:1620847005:1.text: This time, I'll make sure we use a module that's more fun and exciting!
say:6:1620847005:1.source_cn: 这次我一定要选个更有趣、更刺激、内容更丰富的模组！

say:7:1620847006:1.text: But the library's too small for me to really express my creativity...
say:7:1620847006:1.source_cn: 不过图书馆有各种限制，发挥空间太小……不行，不能这么没...

say:8:1620847007:1.text: Get me a spot with enough room, Little Merlin!
say:8:1620847007:1.source_cn: 小梅林，快找个面积足够大，让我能自由发挥的地方！
say:8:1620847007:1.male: Get me a spot with enough room, Little Merlin!
say:8:1620847007:1.female: Get me a spot with enough room, Little Merlin!

choice_prompt:9:1620847007.text: Get me a spot with enough room, Little Merlin!

say:10:1620847008:1.text: Aren't you the great Magister Merlin? Don't lose your prestige in front of the students.
say:10:1620847008:1.source_cn: 你可是“梅林大人”，别在这些学生面前堕了你的威名呦。
say:10:1620847008:1.male: Aren't you the great Magister Merlin? Don't lose your prestige in front of the students.
say:10:1620847008:1.female: Aren't you the great Magister Merlin? Don't lose your prestige in front of the students.

say:11:1620847009:1.text: Is there a place on campus that's spacious, unoccupied, and entirely under your control?

say:14:1620847011:1.text: Your magic tower? A boring choice, but still better than the library.

say:14:1620847011:1.female: Your magic tower? A boring choice, but still better than the library.

say:15:1620847012:1.text: Oh, and you haven't forgotten the day off you promised me, have you?

say:15:1620847012:1.male: Oh, and you haven't forgotten the day off you promised me, have you?

say:17:1620847013:1.female: I only get one day off a year, so I have to spend it on something meaningful!

say:21:1620847017:1.text: Get ready to have your mind blown by my story, hee-hee!
say:21:1620847017:1.source_cn: 好好期待吧，绝对给你们一次超乎想象、绝对难忘的跑团体验...

say:25:1620847019:1.text: I have to say... Contess is truly unlike any other Hypogean, personality-wise.
say:25:1620847019:1.source_cn: 作为恶魔，康缇丝的性格还真是……特别。

say:26:1620847020:1.text: Indeed, she couldn't be more different from the vile ones I saw in textbooks.
say:26:1620847020:1.source_cn: 是啊，和书中记述的邪恶形象简直天差地别。

say:27:1620847021:1.text: Contess could actually be a nice Hypogean! Wait... calling a Hypogean "nice" does sound kind of odd...
